title: Idempotent publication with separate receipts
expected: Identical content at an existing immutable coordinate is idempotent.
Retry only failed operations; do not modify original manifest or claim a cross-registry transaction.

cases.name: partial-success
cases.change: First artifact succeeds, second returns 503 then succeeds.
cases.expect: Receipt preserves both attempts; first artifact is not republished with different bytes.

cases.name: coordinate-conflict
cases.change: Existing coordinate has a different digest.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
